notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying {3}{U}, blinking Donnie & April and Peregrine Drake and causing you to draw a card.
When Donnie & April and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
